import os,json,subprocess,re
from pathlib import Path
link=Path('/home/ubuntu/codex-bridge')
target=Path('/srv/projects/Codex/archive/legacy-bridge')
services=['ssh','nginx','postgresql@16-main','pink-iptv-backend','pink-vpn','fadego-staging','lowcost-europa','pm2-iptvpn-bot','pm2-telegram-robot-leads']
def active():
 return {s:subprocess.run(['systemctl','is-active','--quiet',s],timeout=7).returncode==0 for s in services}
def other_user():
 ignored={os.getpid()};pp=os.getppid()
 while pp>1 and pp not in ignored:
  ignored.add(pp)
  try:
   m=re.search(r'(?m)^PPid:\s*(\d+)$',(Path('/proc')/str(pp)/'status').read_text())
   pp=int(m.group(1)) if m else 0
  except OSError:break
 out=[]
 for proc in Path('/proc').iterdir():
  if not proc.name.isdecimal() or int(proc.name) in ignored:continue
  try:
   cmd=(proc/'cmdline').read_bytes();cwd=os.readlink(proc/'cwd');exe=os.readlink(proc/'exe')
  except OSError:continue
  ref=str(link)
  if os.fsencode(ref) in cmd or cwd==ref or cwd.startswith(ref+'/') or exe.startswith(ref+'/'):
   out.append(int(proc.name))
 return out
state={'operation':'remove_only_codex_home_symlink_after_GitHub_PR_328','status':'BLOCKED','services_before':active(),'symlink_removed':False}
removed=False
try:
 assert all(state['services_before'].values())
 assert target.is_dir() and not target.is_symlink() and target.stat().st_uid==1000
 assert link.is_symlink() and link.resolve(strict=True)==target
 assert link.parent.is_dir() and not link.parent.is_symlink()
 state['preserved_target_entries']=len(list(target.iterdir()))
 for s in services:
  q=subprocess.run(['systemctl','show',s,'--property=ExecStart,ExecStartPre,ExecStartPost,WorkingDirectory,EnvironmentFile','--no-pager'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=9)
  assert q.returncode==0 and str(link) not in q.stdout
 assert not other_user()
 link.unlink()
 removed=True
 assert not link.is_symlink() and not link.exists() and target.is_dir()
 assert active()==state['services_before']
 state['symlink_removed']=True
 state['status']='PASS_CODEX_HOME_SHORTCUT_ABSENT_TARGET_PRESERVED'
except Exception as e:
 state['reason_class']=type(e).__name__
 if removed and not link.exists() and not link.is_symlink():
  try:link.symlink_to(target);state['rollback_restored_link']=True
  except OSError:state['rollback_restored_link']=False
state['services_after']=active()
state['target_preserved_after']=target.is_dir() and not target.is_symlink()
state['alias_absent_after']=not link.exists() and not link.is_symlink()
state['pass']=state['status'].startswith('PASS_') and state['services_after']==state['services_before'] and state['target_preserved_after'] and state['alias_absent_after']
print(json.dumps(state,sort_keys=True))
if not state['pass']:raise SystemExit(4)
